title: Swing signals
subtitle: 4h+1d swing engine with quality gates, plus rule-based confluence on your watchlist. Informational only — not financial advice.
disclaimer: Mechanical setups, not trade orders. Engine uses closed bars, BTC regime, ADX, and min 1.8 R:R for triggers. Confirm on the chart.
watchlistEmptyBody: The scanner only evaluates coins on your watchlist. Add pairs first:

engine.hint: Quality-gated 4h swing scan (Wilder RSI/ADX/ATR, SuperTrend, MACD, BTC regime). Trigger needs a fresh event and ≥1.8 R:R.
engine.empty: No engine setups on the watchlist. Add liquid USDT pairs and wait for the next closed 4h bar.

setups.empty: No confluence yet. Add the 4h swing stack and wait for the next closed bars.
setups.hint: A setup needs at least two of trend (EMA), momentum (RSI), and volume in the last 24h. Grade A is 3/3.

hits.empty: No scanner hits yet. Rules run about once a minute against your watchlist.

rules.createHint: Pick RSI, EMA crossover, and/or volume. Choose whether every selected condition must be true, or one is enough. The saved hit uses that combination.
rules.deleteConfirm: Delete this rule and its saved hits?
rules.empty: No rules yet. Create one or add the 4h swing stack.

lab.title: Historical lab
lab.hint: Replay a saved rule on one symbol. Forward returns are calendar-day close-to-close when data exists.
lab.noSignals: No historical hits in this range
